justification: The model mentions none of the reference steps for either eye including paracentesis, staining, viscoelastic, capsulorhexis, hydrodissection, phacoemulsification, I/A, and IOL insertion/positioning, so coverage is zero and no correct order is present. It actively contradicts the reference by claiming no surgical procedure or instruments are shown. It provides only meta quiz description with no surgical narration, so flow is non-narrative.

Model names no specific steps from paracentesis to wound hydration and is too generic to map, omitting staining, Argentinian-flag tears, scissors repair, phaco quadrants, IOL and hydration. It provides no surgical sequence, only title-to-summary commentary, and falsely claims no flag sign is visible while mischaracterizing it. Technical detail is boilerplate about deliberate movements with no instruments or maneuvers matching the reference.

Model covers only ~2 seconds with generic description and omits all major phases like staining, capsulorhexis, iris hooks, CTS/CTR, phaco, IOL implantation and Gore-Tex fixation. Technical details are vague boilerplate with unsupported redness/blood and speculative early implant, showing no observation of specific instruments or maneuvers.

The narration mentions none of the eight reference phases, using only generic lens/instrument language that cannot be mapped to specific steps. Despite fluent summary style, it contains zero operative detail and chronological information.
